title: Access reviews omit systems and leave removals open

why: Closing removal tickets removes known residual access. Including TMS and the driver app closes the two coverage omissions.

title: Backup recovery has not been demonstrated
gap: Backup job success alone does not establish that data can be restored within the required recovery point and time.
impact: Without demonstrated recovery, a backup failure could prolong interruption of logistics operations.
rec: Perform the scheduled database restore, record sample integrity and recovery time, and retest quarterly.
why: An evidenced restore test checks recovery capability rather than the existence of backups alone.
prov: The reviewer examined Veldhara_Backup_Operations_and_Restore_Log_Q2.xlsx. No interview is recorded.
rationale: Nightly backups ran, but there was no restore test in the quarter and failover did not restore a retained copy. Backup job success alone does not establish that data can be restored within the required recovery point and time.
quote: Veldhara_Backup_Operations_and_Restore_Log_Q2.xlsx , Characters 543–609 No restore test was recorded between 1 July and 30 September 2026.
